architecture: NYC Open Data -> Azure ingestion -> ADLS Gen2 -> Strategy Mosaic -> dashboard and review app
strategy_model: Heat and Hot Water Review Model
strategy_dashboard: Heat and Hot Water Review Dashboard

kpis.label: Unresolved heat or hot-water complaints
kpis.definition: Distinct complaint IDs whose latest complaint_status is OPEN in the Strategy source snapshot.
kpis.why_it_matters: Shows the main complaint queue for supervisors to review now.

kpis.label: Unresolved candidate violations
kpis.definition: Distinct candidate violation IDs whose violationstatus is Open. The heat classification still needs review.
kpis.why_it_matters: Shows possible enforcement records that may need staff verification.

kpis.label: Buildings with heat or hot-water reports
kpis.definition: Distinct HPD building IDs with at least one approved heat or hot-water complaint category in the source window.
kpis.why_it_matters: Shows the number of buildings an HPD supervisor may need to review.

kpis.label: Distinct heat or hot-water complaints
kpis.definition: Distinct complaint_id values. Problem rows are not counted as separate complaints.
kpis.why_it_matters: Prevents one complaint with several problem rows from being counted more than once.

kpis.label: Candidate violation records
kpis.definition: Distinct violation IDs found by the provisional heat or hot-water text screen and linked at building level.
kpis.why_it_matters: Flags building histories for review without claiming that a particular complaint caused a violation.

kpis.label: Buildings with a candidate violation
kpis.definition: Buildings in the complaint summary with at least one candidate violation record.
kpis.why_it_matters: Narrows the review set while preserving buildings with no matching violation.

kpis.label: Supporting 311 requests
kpis.definition: HPD heat or hot-water 311 requests in the source window. These remain supporting context until the linkage is validated.
kpis.why_it_matters: Shows when requests were made without treating a closed request as proof that heat or hot water was restored.

kpis.label: Problem rows checked
kpis.definition: Raw HPD problem rows read during ingestion. This is not the complaint count.
kpis.why_it_matters: Makes the difference between source rows and distinct complaints visible.

Apartment, address, person, location, and source free-text fields are excluded.
